title: App Studio 改版（1-6）：拆分 StudioDesignSurface.tsx——外框、发布/草稿、保存、右侧栏各成模块，纯重构不改行为
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: the maintainer in the area thread, 2026-11-26 12:52Z: 「StudioDesignSurface 这个文件是不是应该分拆」. The area answered yes, after #37456. Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 1 tail, before phase 2).
Grade: area:ux · Task · p2 (takes the parent's grade) · evidence: origin/main `818615b9`. The file is 1,745 lines. `StudioDesignSurfaceBody` alone runs from line 249 to the end (~1,500 lines) and holds the top bar, publish and drafts, save, the menu mount and the right slot. 71 test files are named after the surface. Phase 1 cards #37454, #37455 and #37456 all had to serialise on this one file.
Reader: area `ux-37424` (seat `repo:objectstack#5`), an `os-dev` subagent after #37456 merges.

Blocked-by: #37456 (it deletes the top bar from this file; splitting first would collide with #37454 and #37456, both in flight).

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：把 Studio 主框架这个 1700 多行的大文件按职责拆开，用户看不到任何变化。
- 为什么：第一阶段几张卡都卡在这个文件上，第二阶段（列表页、完整概览）还要再改它，先拆开以后改界面就不用排队。
- 什么时候：删除顶栏（#37456）合并以后马上做，第二阶段开工前。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- Pure refactor of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` after #37456. Split by responsibility into modules, each with one owner:
  - the frame (the two columns, the menu mount and the slot host);
  - publish and drafts state (the Pending tab and badge wiring);
  - save-entry plumbing;
  - the right slot / assistant;
  - the scope resolution (package, `~org` / `~all`, missing package).
  Hooks and components move. No behaviour, prop, address or copy changes. `StudioDesignSurface` keeps its export and props for its callers.
- The tests move with the code they pin, or keep importing the surface. ⛔ No test is deleted, skipped or loosened. Re-pointing an import is fine.
- Decide the cut points from the file as #37456 leaves it, not from this list. List them in the PR body with line counts before and after.

## Acceptance

- No behaviour change: the full app-shell suite and the console E2E are green with no assertion edited except imports.
- No module over ~400 lines, unless the PR body says why.
- `git log --follow` friendly: move code in its own commits, separate from any renames.
